changelog:
Initial release of bank-health-fdic-data:

- Instantly check any US bank’s financial health, assets, deposits, and status using live FDIC institution data.
- No API key or signup required; pay-per-call in USDC via x402 with your OpenClaw wallet.
- Designed for assessing bank/counterparty risk and verifying FDIC-active institutions.
- Simple HTTPS GET endpoint for easy integration with AI agents and fintech workflows.
